name: vLLM#27579: AITER FP8 GEMM performance on MI355
notes: PR updates AITER FP8 linear check for different platforms. Removes is_fp8_fnuz check, enabling AITER FP8 GEMM on MI355. Benchmark: DeepSeek-V3 on MI355, AITER FP8 GEMM outperforms Triton GEMM by 10-14% QPS. Accuracy: gsm8k 0.9515. Demonstrates ROCm FP8 kernel performance.
